Serivisi ya Accessibility: ni yo nzira yonyine Android yemerera porogaramu gukanda no gusunika kuri wowe. Mareco iyikoresha mu gushushanya ibikoresho bireremba, mu gushyira hejuru ya ecran igice kitagaragara igihe ufata, no mu gusubiramo ibikorwa byawe byo gukanda no gusunika. Ntishobora gusoma ecran yawe, amagambo y’ibanga yawe cyangwa ubutumwa bwawe.

Gukanda buto: gusa igihe ufata cyangwa igihe ukora, kugira ngo Mareco ibashe gufata buto ya Inyuma / Ahabanza / Porogaramu ziheruka no kumenya ihagarikwa ryihutirwa rya Ongera ijwi + Gabanya ijwi. Inyandiko wandika ntizibikwa na rimwe.
Porogaramu iri imbere: ikoreshwa gusa ku mutekano wa “Kora gusa igihe iyi porogaramu ifunguye”, uwo ushobora guhitamo.
Mareco nta burenganzira na buke bwa internet ifite, bityo nta kintu gishobora gusohoka kuri telefoni yawe.

Android 13 n’izirenga zibuza porogaramu zashyizweho mu buryo bw’intoki gukoresha Accessibility kugeza igihe ubyemereye:
1. Kanda “Amakuru ya porogaramu”.
2. Kanda utudomo dutatu tuboneka hejuru iburyo.
3. Hitamo “Emerera igenamiterere rigenzurwa” hanyuma wemeze.
4. Subira inyuma maze ufungure serivisi.

Ku gukoresha igihe kirekire, shyira ikoreshwa rya bateri ya Mareco kuri “Nta mbogamizi” (Amakuru ya porogaramu → Bateri), kandi ukomeze charger ihujwe. Macro igihe ikora, Mareco ituma ecran ikomeza kaka.

Buto y’ubururu ● / ▶: itangira gufata (uburyo bwa “Gufata macro”) cyangwa igakora macro yawe (uburyo bwa “Tangira macro”). Igihe ufata cyangwa ikora, ihinduka ■: kanda kugira ngo uhagarike. Nyuma yo gufata, isaba kuyita izina no kuyibika.
Kanda igihe kirekire buto y’ubururu: uhagarare cyangwa ukomeze (igihe ufata cyangwa ukora), cyangwa uhagarike (igihe wahagaze).
Gear: hitamo “Gufata macro” cyangwa “Tangira macro”, hitemo macro isanzwe, uhindure igenamiterere ryayo ryo gukora n’ibindi byose.
Imyambi ine: kurura ikibaho aho ushaka hose. X: funga ikibaho (uzagifungura usubiye muri porogaramu). Kanda igihe kirekire buto kugira ngo ubone izina ryayo.

1. Muri Mareco, kanda Tangira gufata. Ikibaho kireremba kirigaragara.
2. Fungura umukino wawe.
3. Kanda buto y’ubururu ● igihe witeguye.
4. Kora ibikorwa byawe nk’uko bisanzwe.

Hagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ukoresheje ■, buto ya HAGARIKA iri muri porogaramu, cyangwa ukande Ongera ijwi + Gabanya ijwi icyarimwe.
Live (isanzwe): Mareco ifata ibikanda byawe kandi igasubiramo buri gikorwa muri porogaramu ako kanya urekuye urutoki, bityo umukino ugasubiza igihe ufata.
Plan: ibikanda bifatwa gusa; porogaramu ntisubiza. Koresha ubu buryo niba Live itera ibibazo.

• Porogaramu ntishobora kureba ibikanda bijya muri indi porogaramu. Ni cyo gituma gufata gukoresha igice gikorera mu mucyo kandi kigasubiramo ibikorwa byawe. Gukanda gushya mu kanya gato igihe ikorwa risubirwamo gishobora kutamenyekana, bityo wirinde gukanda kenshi cyane vuba-vuba igihe ufata, cyangwa ukoreshe uburyo bwa Plan.
• Ecran zimwe zibuza ibikorwa byikora: aho wandika ijambo ry’ibanga, porogaramu za banki n’izibuza ibikoresho bya Accessibility.
• Gusa buto ya Inyuma, Ahabanza na Porogaramu ziheruka ni zo zishobora gufatwa nk’akanda ko ku buto. Buto z’ijwi, iya kamera n’izindi ntizishobora gusubirwamo.
• Nta kintu gikora igihe ecran izimye cyangwa ifunze. Mareco ituma ecran ikomeza kaka mu gihe macro ikora kandi ihagarara niba izimye.
• Fata kandi usubiremo ecran iri mu buryo bumwe (ihagaze cyangwa iryamye). Niba ingano ya ecran itandukanye, Mareco ihindura imyanya kandi ikakuburira.
• Android ishobora guhagarika porogaramu ziri inyuma kugira ngo ibike bateri. Shyira ikoreshwa rya bateri ya Mareco kuri “Nta mbogamizi” ku gukoresha igihe kirekire.
